## Owner re-review PASS — standalone Search handoff remediation

Re-review of exact candidate `843693ea7e3612a662a5331daaedef557d40fee1` / tree `72b1c263650951be118a5f23e820d5dca8e4e621` finds the previously observed native false-success path remediated within the authorized PM-03 boundary.

### Verified handoff contract

- Main readiness ACK is no longer treated as navigation success.
- Rust arms a fixed navigation binding using generation / nonce / Search session / Search revision.
- Main sends a bounded `acknowledge_search_navigation` outcome only after Main-side navigation validation.
- Positive ACK is emitted only after `applySearchNavigation(...)` succeeds; mounted state commits before native Search is allowed to hide.
- File-less commands such as Automation / Settings preserve generation, nonce, Search session/revision and current-view continuity, but no longer depend on unrelated File Library selected/focused projection churn.
- File-result activation retains strict selected-file / selection-identity / focused-ID continuity and the existing ID-only activation path.
- Rust revalidates the original Search session/revision/visible phase after Main readiness ACK and again before final close.
- Final Search hide is scoped to the original session/revision; the old unconditional post-handoff `None` hide is no longer the successful activation path.
- Navigation rejection / timeout / Main recreation / reopened Search fail closed and leave the active Search recoverable.
- Standalone blur is suppressed while activation is pending, including invalidation of a pre-handoff blur timer, so focus transfer to Main cannot close Search before navigation commit.
- Canonical native `automation`, inbound legacy `rules`, and resident `?view=automation` behavior remain intact.
- Global Index issue #323 is untouched.

### Permission boundary

The new acknowledgement command is Main-only, fixed-shape, generation/nonce/session/revision-bound and carries only an applied boolean. Search capability received no new write authority. No path, view, SQL, Rule, Automation execution or filesystem authority is added.

### Exact-head validation

CI [37424135807](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/37424135807) is SUCCESS on the exact head.

Observed hosted coverage includes:

- frontend/architecture suite: 175 files / 1,800 tests PASS, including `standaloneSearchHandoff.test.tsx` 12/12;
- Windows Rust tests, watcher durable regression, Clippy, filesystem hardening, exact-candidate resident lifecycle build and real Windows background/resident regression PASS;
- macOS Rust tests, Clippy and lifecycle checks PASS;
- Windows/macOS release compile PASS;
- Search performance lane PASS.

Skipped package/other routing jobs remain skipped and are not counted as PASS.

### Owner disposition

**PM-03 STANDALONE SEARCH HANDOFF REMEDIATION — OWNER RE-REVIEW PASS / WINDOWS REQUALIFICATION AUTHORIZED.**

Use only the fresh candidate built from `843693ea...`.

This is qualification authorization only. PR #322 remains Draft/unmerged; #273 and #323 remain open.
